text: With short-form video transforming how dance is experienced, studios are evolving into creative spaces where dancers rehearse and film content.
Space is stretching in all directions, meaning galaxies are moving further away from each other every second.
Cricket is a bat-and-ball sport that originated in 16th-century England, featuring a 22-yard pitch and iconic events like the International Cricket Council World Cups.
Invented in Persia in the 10th century, heels were designed to give wealthy men more height and status.
Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence (AI) that trains computers to extract meaningful information, understand, and interpret digital images and videos like a human brain does.
Nvidia is making major headlines with a potential $250 billion backing deal for OpenAI, a partnership with Kawasaki for maritime AI, and a massive $500 billion order backlog for AI hardware.
Many professional dance companies now offer hybrid training programs that combine in-studio instruction with online masterclasses, making elite technique accessible to students far from major cities.
Improvisational dance forms like contact improvisation rely on partners responding to shifting weight and momentum in real time rather than following a set choreography.
Black holes distort the space around them so severely that not even light can escape once it crosses the event horizon.
Astronomers use spectroscopy to determine the chemical composition of distant stars by analyzing the specific wavelengths of light they emit and absorb.
A century, scoring 100 runs or more in a single innings, is considered one of the most prestigious individual achievements a batter can reach in cricket.
Twenty20 cricket was introduced in the early 2000s to create a faster, shorter format that could be completed in about three hours, drawing new audiences to the sport.
Sustainable fashion has grown as brands experiment with recycled fabrics, plant-based dyes, and take-back programs to reduce textile waste.
The little black dress became a wardrobe staple after designers popularized it in the early 20th century as a versatile, understated alternative to elaborate formalwear.
Convolutional neural networks became the dominant architecture for image recognition tasks because they can automatically learn spatial hierarchies of visual features.
Object detection models not only classify what appears in an image but also draw bounding boxes to pinpoint exactly where each object is located.
Facial recognition systems rely on identifying distinctive landmarks on a face, such as the distance between the eyes, to match a person against stored data.
Nvidia's GPUs, originally designed for rendering video game graphics, became the foundation of modern AI training because of their ability to process many parallel calculations at once.
The company's CUDA software platform allows developers to harness Nvidia hardware for general-purpose computing well beyond graphics rendering.
Nvidia's data center segment has grown to represent the largest share of its revenue, driven by demand from cloud providers building out AI infrastructure.
